title: How A Farmer's Son Created Groww

What if I told you that India's largest stock broker was built by someone who grew up in a village so remote, it didn't even have an English-medium school?
Lalit Keshre's journey started with separation from his parents at just 7 years old. From self-studying for IIT through postal coaching to watching his first startup completely fail, his path to success was anything but straightforward.

But it was these very failures that taught him lessons most entrepreneurs never learn. While working at Flipkart, he discovered something that would change how millions of Indians invest their money.
In 2017, when established players dominated the market, Lalit made a decision that seemed crazy to everyone around him. A strategy so counterintuitive that it would mean zero revenue for years.
Yet today, Groww serves over 37 million Indians across 98% of the country's pin codes.

How did he do it? What was the "opposite" strategy that everyone else missed? And what lesson from a failed startup became the key to building a billion-dollar company?

Watch to discover the untold story of Groww.
